
=== MANA BASE (27 front-face lands + 0 MDFC land-backs, 0 truly tapped) ===
  accelerants counted: 24  (restricted, excluded: none)

--- sources model (colour), worst lines (8000 sims over 3 reps, seed 17) ---
  T6 {C}           65.6% ±0.8   Endbringer
  T5 {C}           76.1% ±0.5   Reality Smasher
  T4 {C}           84.7% ±0.3   Thought-Knot Seer
  T3 {C}           89.2% ±0.6   Matter Reshaper
  T2 {C}           90.4% ±0.4   Spatial Contortion, Warping Wail

--- play simulation, 20000 trials over 3 reps, seed 17 ---
  line                                             on play     on draw        baseline(any N on TN)
  Endbringer T6                                  74.0±0.1%   81.8±0.3%     74.0±0.1% / 81.8±0.3%
  Reality Smasher T5                             78.4±0.1%   85.3±0.3%     78.5±0.1% / 85.4±0.3%
  Thought-Knot Seer T4                           81.5±0.2%   87.6±0.4%     81.8±0.3% / 87.9±0.4%
  Matter Reshaper T3                             81.4±0.2%   87.3±0.5%     82.1±0.3% / 87.8±0.5%
  Spatial Contortion T2                          83.6±0.2%   88.2±0.4%     86.7±0.1% / 90.8±0.4%
  Zhulodok, Void Gorger on curve                 74.0±0.1%   81.8±0.3%     74.0±0.1% / 81.8±0.3%

  Diagnosis: a line CLOSE to its baseline is a QUANTITY problem (no land swap will help).
  A line FAR BELOW its baseline is a COLOUR problem (a filter land for that pip is the answer).
  A gap smaller than the two ± beside it is noise, not a finding.

  No mulligan is modelled: every opening seven is kept, so the figures above are FLOORS.
  38.2% of opening sevens hold at most one land (9.9% hold none), off 27 lands in 99.
  Those hands are kept here and shipped back in real play. The share moves with
  land count, so it skews deck-to-deck comparison and not just the level.
